scene: At 18:51 (30 Seedwake 1156 AC), Maddoc returns on foot to his modest family cottage near Thistlebell Yard after spending the afternoon with Tessa and Bram. They ate permitted windfall apples at Mossgate Common; no lasting provisions gained. Maddoc attempted four hours of independent Soul self-awareness: d20 6+2=8 vs DC14, failure, 0/100 progress, 2 Stamina spent (34/36), no power awakened. Bram favours Arcane, Tessa practises martial footwork. Friends intend to meet tomorrow.
summary: Maddoc returned home at 18:51 after apples and 4h Soul self-awareness: failed check, no progress, 34/36 stamina; friends plan tomorrow.
